parsed.rationale: I disagree with the team's 'normal' read: V1–V4 show QS complexes with about 2–3 mm ST elevation in V2–V3, followed by deep T-wave inversions, while QRS in I and V6 is not wide enough for LBBB, so this looks like an evolving anterior STEMI (LV aneurysm is the main alternative) and needs urgent clinical correlation.
